description: The most complete and accurate Vedic astrology (Jyotish) MCP server. 16 specialized tools powered by Swiss Ephemeris with Lahiri ayanamsha, strictly following classical Jyotish Shastra. Returns exhaustive structured data for professional-grade horoscopes, birth charts (Kundali), Dasha predictions, Muhurta timing, marriage compatibility, transits, Shadbala, divisional charts (D1-D60), Prashna (horary), Varshaphal (annual forecasts), and Hindu festival calendar. Also powers financial astrology: market timing via planetary transits, trade optimization via Muhurta, daily sentiment via Panchanga, and event outcome prediction via Prashna. Purpose-built for AI agents with free tier (2 req/day), x402 USDC auto-payment, and instant API key registration.
